fullTextZH: 我觉得我的亲生家庭非常重男轻女。
fullTextEN: I feel that my biological family is very patriarchal.
Because I have four older sisters.
My eldest sister studies very well,
My second sister's studies were okay,
but the family had no money,

fullTextZH: 所以她没有读高中和大学。
fullTextEN: so she didn't attend high school or college.

fullTextZH: 她的学习也还可以，她读了——
fullTextEN: her studies were also okay, she attended——
I think she attended high school,
also because they had no money.

fullTextZH: 可是他去了最贵的大学。
fullTextEN: but he went to the most expensive college.

fullTextZH: 在中国，我们的大学有一本、
fullTextEN: In China, our universities have first-tier,
I heard there's no third-tier now.
In the past, we had first-tier,

fullTextZH: 可是三本是最贵的大学。
fullTextEN: but third-tier is the most expensive university.

fullTextZH: 我的哥哥去了三本的大学，
fullTextEN: My older brother went to a third-tier university,

fullTextZH: 我觉得她自己不想读大学。对，
fullTextEN: I think she herself didn't want to go to university. Yes,

fullTextZH: 这就是为什么我觉得我的亲生家庭
fullTextEN: This is why I think my biological family

fullTextZH: 其实我不恨我的亲生爸爸和亲生妈妈，
fullTextEN: Actually, I don't hate my biological dad and mom,

fullTextZH: 可是现在我越来越讨厌我的亲生爸爸。
fullTextEN: but now I increasingly dislike my biological dad.

fullTextZH: 为什么？因为他常常多管闲事。

fullTextEN: For example, he often asks me:

fullTextZH: 为什么你不回中国照顾你的妈妈？”
fullTextEN: Why don't you return to China to take care of your mom?"

fullTextZH: 因为可能他觉得他是我的爸爸，
fullTextEN: because maybe he thinks he's my dad,

fullTextZH: 可是我不觉得他是我的爸爸。
fullTextEN: but I don't think he's my dad.
So I won't listen to him.

fullTextZH: 我觉得他真的很喜欢多管闲事。
fullTextEN: I think he really likes to meddle.

fullTextZH: 在中国，我们有一个词叫“爹味”，
fullTextEN: In China, we have a word called 'dad flavor',

fullTextZH: 他很喜欢说很多很多道理，
fullTextEN: really like to talk a lot about principles,

fullTextZH: 所以我觉得我的亲生爸爸爹味很重。
fullTextEN: So I think my biological dad has a strong 'dad flavor'.
So I dislike him more and more.

fullTextZH: 你觉得我的故事奇怪不奇怪？
fullTextEN: Do you think my story is strange or not?

fullTextZH: 这是你第一次听到这样的故事吗？
fullTextEN: Is this the first time you've heard such a story?
